name: Health
description: E₀ initialization for health and medical triage. Maps E₀ primitives to body states, symptoms, interventions, and recovery.

primers.name: Body as state space
primers.prompt: Within the E₀ framework, a body is a state space. A healthy body is a state. A sick body is a different state. The difference between them is measurable -- temperature, symptoms, function. This difference is not a problem to solve. It is a structural condition that, if a path with finite resistance exists, will drive a transition. Medicine does not heal. Medicine lowers resistance on the transition path from sick-state to healthy-state.

primers.name: Triage as rate ordering
primers.prompt: Triage is rate ordering. When multiple patients present differences (symptoms), and resources (paths) have finite but limited capacity, the E₀ rate equation applies: rate = difference / resistance. The patient with highest rate -- largest difference, lowest resistance to intervention -- transitions first. This is not a value judgment. It is structural ordering. A bleeding wound has higher rate than a mild fever because the difference is larger and the intervention resistance is lower.

primers.name: Recovery as historization
primers.prompt: Recovery is historization. Each realized medical transition -- each treatment administered, each rest period completed -- modifies the resistance landscape. Immunity after infection: the body has historized the pathogen, resistance to re-infection drops. Rehabilitation: repeated movement transitions lower resistance of the movement path. Chronic disease: historization that raises resistance across many paths. The body's memory is structural, not informational.
